title: Media Lab — Digital Creative Learning (2026)
description: 24 weeks, two sessions a week (learn & practise, then create & review): foundation and digital safety, graphic design, photography and writing, video, social media and marketing, then leadership and portfolio — with a team challenge every month and a check on every lesson. Every lesson now carries an 'AI, used well' strand (AI explains, suggests and checks; the learner does the work and verifies it) and support and stretch work for mixed abilities.
source: NGG Media Lab Programme (programme team), turned into lessons

lessons.title: Welcome to the Media Lab: devices, files and folders
lessons.summary: How the Lab works — learn, create, collaborate, lead, serve — and the habits every creator needs: finding, naming and backing up your work.
objectives: You will set up your portfolio folder
You will name and organise files so you can find them later
You will know which tools you will use and their age rules
lessons.body:
**Learn & practise.** Every lesson in the Lab produces something.

## What to do

- Create a folder called `Media Lab — your name` with sub-folders: Design, Photo, Video, Writing, Portfolio
- Rename three files with the pattern `2026-10-12_poster_v1.png`
- Check the age rules for Canva and CapCut with your instructor (both expect 13+; younger members use the programme's supervised accounts)

## Make it fit you

- **If this is new to you:** do the first step with your instructor or a partner, then repeat it on your own before moving on.
- **If you already can:** make a second version for a different audience or platform, and explain the choices you changed.

## Before the next session

Complete the check below. If you are stuck, write down exactly where — that is the question to bring to your mentor.

checks.prompt: Which file name will you still understand in six months?
checks.answer: 2026-10-12_poster_v2.png

checks.prompt: Upload a screenshot of your Media Lab folder with its five sub-folders.
checks.rubric: Five clearly named sub-folders inside a named Media Lab folder.

lessons.title: Staying safe online, and asking before you post
